quarterly_data.quarter: CEVA press release: Ceva and LG Electronics Partner to Accelerate UWB Adoption (09-09-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Partner LG Electronics: CEVA and LG Electronics announced a collaboration combining Ceva-Waves UWB baseband IP and software with UWB RF technology from LG's SoC Center (supporting TSMC's 22nm process) as a complete Ultra-Wideband solution for automotive, industrial and consumer SoCs. The companies have already secured a major U.S. semiconductor company (unnamed) as a customer for the combined solution. CEVA's next-generation Ceva-Waves UWB architecture supports the IEEE 802.15.4ab standard, including UWB radar sensing and the new channels of the next-generation standard.
quarterly_data.figure: one major U.S. semiconductor customer (unnamed); LG UWB RF on TSMC 22nm; IEEE 802.15.4ab
